purpose: Independent claim-scoped geometric revalidation by comparing PyMuPDF and Docling Parse extraction from the same immutable PDF page.

authority.required_reopen_mechanism: formal claim-scoped M0G-REOPEN when frozen superstructure geometry is affected

coordinate_policy.origin_reconciliation: evaluate direct and vertical-flip mappings; record selected mapping and score; never hide the transform

tolerance_profile.note: Thresholds are explicit starting values only. They do not authorize DOC/MIS promotion and must be calibrated against known-good N12 source regions before any governance change.

outcomes.AGREE: Both extractors independently reproduce at least the declared agreement ratio within every active tolerance.
outcomes.PARTIAL: Substantial but incomplete concordance; human/source review required.
outcomes.DISAGREE: Concordance below the partial threshold or geometric residual exceeds tolerance.
outcomes.MISSING_DOCLING: Docling Parse produced no comparable geometry.
outcomes.UNCOMPARABLE: Extraction or coordinate reconciliation could not produce a defensible common comparison frame.

epistemic_guard: Agreement between two software extractors is corroboration of a source reading, not documentary authority by itself. The original PDF remains the source and human/source binding remains mandatory.
